scope: MVP1–MVP8: интеграция уже принятых SM1/P7/Item/Construction/persistence в одну запускаемую двухклиентскую сцену. Никаких новых владельцев канонического состояния. По явно одобренному HA-V0-MVP3-LIVE-PLAYER-HOOKS-R1 дополнительно разрешены четыре указанных M3 owner-файла только для live-player handoff hooks; точный bounded repair V0-MVP3-R8-LIVE-PLAYER-OWNER-HOOKS. Для порученного MVP4 отдельно разрешены только именованный read-only validation workflow и именованный MVP4 launcher; это не расширение foundation/runtime ownership. Для явно порученного MVP5 дополнительно разрешён один именованный read-only validation workflow по MVP5_IMPLEMENTATION_R1_RU.md; остальные owner fences неизменны. По принятому HA-V0-MVP-LIVE-SIMULATOR-BASELINE-R1 whole-MVP acceptance дополнительно обязана соответствовать docs/control/mvp-act0-r1/MVP_LIVE_SIMULATOR_BASELINE_R1_RU.md: MVP5–MVP8 должны образовать одну live two-client gameplay composition, а не набор изолированных лабораторных PASS. Это refinement product acceptance без нового canonical owner и без разрешения foundation/runtime ownership transfer.
required_outputs: V0-MVP-LIVE-SIMULATOR-BASELINE-R1 connected live two-client gameplay story
Exact-head Evidence Map and fresh independent roles
stop_conditions: New canonical owner or foundation change outside the four M3 owner files approved in HA-V0-MVP3-LIVE-PLAYER-HOOKS-R1 required
Missing canonical ACT0 or stale epoch
Attempt to claim MVP6/MVP7/MVP8 from isolated backend or lab PASS without the mandatory live-simulator baseline sub-gates
Mandatory live-simulator baseline sub-gate requires an owner-native change outside allowed paths without a separate bounded scope amendment and required Harness/Human gate
risk_reasons: Composes mutable shared world, authority handoff and exactly-once recovery
Whole-MVP acceptance now requires one connected live two-client item/construction/recovery gameplay composition, so isolated subsystem PASS must not be promoted as product completion
notes: ACT0 records dispatch authority, not a running agent. No product predicate is complete at activation. User explicitly approved HA-V0-MVP3-LIVE-PLAYER-HOOKS-R1 with «разрешаю, реализуй»; scope amendment is bounded by docs/control/mvp-act0-r1/work-order-mvp3-live-hooks-r8.v1.json and does not authorize main merge or acceptance. MVP4 execution requested explicitly with «реализуй MVP4» and «продолжи работу над MVP4». Coordinator validation-scope correction MVP4_VALIDATION_SCOPE_R1_RU.md adds exactly two named integration/validation paths after fresh review finding 4000014122; old out-of-fence executions remain historical diagnostics, not retroactively independent acceptance. MVP5 explicitly requested with «реализуй MVP5: exactly-once material output» after MVP4 closure at d7876073. Director adds exactly .github/workflows/mvp5-material-output-validation.yml before its creation; see docs/control/mvp-act0-r1/MVP5_IMPLEMENTATION_R1_RU.md. On 2026-09-14 the user instructed «внеси правки» after review of PR #632; HA-V0-MVP-LIVE-SIMULATOR-BASELINE-R1 is therefore adopted into the active feature lineage. Binding sources: docs/control/mvp-act0-r1/MVP_LIVE_SIMULATOR_BASELINE_R1_RU.md and docs/control/mvp-act0-r1/mvp-live-simulator-baseline-r1.v1.json. Existing verified MVP1–MVP4 are not reopened. No wildcard workflow authorization, history rewrite, main merge, runtime merge or self-acceptance is granted by this acceptance refinement.

design_brief.problem_statement: Принятые компоненты ещё не доказаны как единый пользовательский сценарий; без refinement top-level predicates можно ошибочно закрыть набором изолированных backend/lab PASS.
design_brief.current_behavior: MVP1–MVP4 уже дают shared scene, two-client world, seamless и canonical dig; MVP5 идёт. Item/Construction/recovery ещё не обязаны машинно доказываться как одна связанная live composition.
design_brief.desired_behavior: Два live клиента видят один мир, пересекают A→B→A, реально экипируют canonical tool, копают, получают exactly-once material, выполняют pickup/drop/share/container, несут непустой item state через seam, строят одну Construction из canonical resources, затем проходят reconnect/restart/resync и продолжают bounded gameplay loop с одинаковым canonical state.
alternatives_considered: Accept isolated Item/Construction/persistence laboratory PASS without one live gameplay story
design_brief.selected_design: Small composition adapters over existing owners, with V0-MVP-LIVE-SIMULATOR-BASELINE-R1 as mandatory product-acceptance refinement for MVP5–MVP8
design_brief.why_selected: No duplicate truth or new foundation; product completion now proves a usable simulator baseline rather than disconnected subsystem demonstrations.
expected_risks: False product completion from isolated subsystem PASS
Loss or duplication of non-empty carrying state across seam
Recovery that restores terrain but not item/container/construction state
validation_plan: Live tool-gated dig and exactly-once accounting
Real-resource Construction with replication and collision
Reconnect/restart/late-join recovery of full base state
One connected bounded two-client gameplay workload
